content.text:
## Recommended hero pattern (Amazon agencies, professional / 30+ buyers)

Docs do not name “age 30+” explicitly. Audience is framed as **mid-market Amazon sellers / ambitious FBA brands** (`.cursor/plans/2026-09-02-homepage-redesign-brief.md`). Target mood is **Tier B boutique premium (Olifant) + Tier C conversion (AMZ Dudes)** — clean, credible, outcome-led, not flashy Tier E or dark enterprise Tier A (`obsidian/07-UX/Design-Inspiration.md`).

**Concrete hero recipe:**

| Element | Recommendation | Source |
|--------|----------------|--------|
| Layout | **Split:** text left, trust/product visual right (Olifant). Skip dark full-width Canopy hero unless brand direction changes. | `Design-Inspiration.md` (Tier B hero; Tier A “Skip: dark hero”) |
| H1 | **Outcome-focused**, not a feature list. Locked copy: *Full-service Amazon growth for ambitious FBA brands* | `Niche-Website-Standards.md` (homepage checklist); redesign brief; `docs/seo/SITE-SEO-MAP.md` |
| Title vs H1 | Title carries primary keyword (*Amazon Account Management Agency \| eCom Gliders*); H1 is outcome + secondary growth framing | `SITE-SEO-MAP.md`; redesign brief SEO table |
| Subhead | Services + in-house specialists (PPC, listing, content, catalog) | redesign brief §1 |
| CTA | Primary above fold: **Get Free Audit** → `/free-audit-2/`; sticky header CTA elsewhere | `Niche-Website-Standards.md`; redesign brief; `Competitor-Analysis.md` CTA row |
| Trust in hero | Partner badge + “since 2018” line; phone optional in header/hero | redesign brief; `Niche-Website-Standards.md` conversion list |
| Right visual | Partner/client imagery **or** BrowserMockup (PPC / listing / account tabs) — Cursor-style product preview | redesign brief; `typescript_web_stack_*.plan.md`; `Browser-Mockup-Spec.md` |
| Immediately below | **4 stat cards** ($112M+, 95%, 20+, 2018) — AMZ Dudes pattern | `Design-Inspiration.md`; redesign brief §3 |
| Typography | Larger display H1 (~48–56px), more whitespace, keep brand colors | `Design-Inspiration.md`; `Design-System.md` |
| Avoid | Emoji/Unicode icons, exit-intent as primary contact, “AI-powered/magic” copy, anonymous testimonials, inflated metrics | `Design-Inspiration.md` “Strictly avoid”; `Niche-Website-Standards.md` |

Homepage section 1 in the wireframe: **Hero (Olifant layout + AMZ Dudes CTA urgency)** then trust bar → stats (`Design-Inspiration.md` proposed order; `Page-Templates.md` §1).

---

## KEEP vs CHANGE (current → proposed)

**KEEP** (`Niche-Website-Standards.md` “Already has”; redesign brief content migration; `SITE-SEO-MAP.md` metrics):

- Verified proof: **$112M+**, **95% retention**, **20+ in-house**, **since 2018**
- **Amazon Ads Verified Partner** in trust line / bar
- Free audit path `/free-audit-2/` as primary CTA destination
- Brand colors (do not copy competitor palettes)
- Outcome + differentiation voice (in-house specialists, not call center / dashboard)

**CHANGE** (`Competitor-Analysis.md` gaps; redesign brief “What to remove”; `Design-Inspiration.md` / `Design-System.md`):

- Hero layout → **split boutique**, not basic/generic Tier E polish
- H1 → locked outcome line; **increase type scale** to Olifant range
- Add **primary CTA above the fold** (competitors all have header/hero CTA; current gap: no header CTA)
- Right side → **BrowserMockup** (or strong trust visual), not weak static stock
- Pair hero with **stat cards above/near fold** (Tier C)
- Remove clutter tied to old homepage chrome: duplicate nav, anchor service hashes, inactive mega headings (redesign brief) — not hero copy itself, but first-viewport trust

`Page-Templates.md` homepage hero is only a pointer to the 12-section brief + SEO H1 “outcome-focused”; detail lives in the plan + `SITE-SEO-MAP.md`.

---

## Competitor hero takeaways (already documented)

| Agency | Hero takeaway | Adopt / skip | Source |
|--------|---------------|--------------|--------|
| **Olifant** | Outcome headline + application CTA; split left-text / right visual; optional guarantee under hero | **Primary layout + copy pattern** | `COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md`; `Design-Inspiration.md` |
| **AMZ Dudes** | Outcome headline + **stat cards immediately below**; sticky CTA | **Adopt stats + CTA urgency**; avoid emoji / exit-intent as primary | same |
| **Canopy** | Dark high-contrast hero; bold outcome + single CTA | **Outcome + single CTA yes**; **skip dark hero** and enterprise scale | `Design-Inspiration.md` Tier A Skip |
| **MAG** | Trust density, FAQ depth (less hero-specific) | Trust bar density after hero | `COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md` |
| **Sequence** | Comparison / AEO (post-hero) | Not hero; use later on page | same |
| **SalesDuo / Incrementum / Evolve** | Tabs, tools, content-library heroes | Segmentation later; skip fake AI / tools you don’t have; use blog strength lower on page | same |

Canonical hero line from research: **Outcome headline + CTA + trust line** (`Competitor-Analysis.md` section patterns).

---

## SEO H1 (homepage)

From `docs/seo/SITE-SEO-MAP.md` (aligned with redesign brief):

- **H1:** Full-service Amazon growth for ambitious FBA brands  
- **Title:** Amazon Account Management Agency \| eCom Gliders  
- **Primary keyword** in title; H1 supports growth / full-service intent  
- Schema around homepage: Organization, WebSite, FAQPage (FAQ is not in the hero)

`docs/seo/URL-INVENTORY.md` only templates H1; it does not override the map.

---

**Bottom line:** Ship an **Olifant split hero** with the **locked outcome H1**, Free Audit CTA, partner/since-2018 trust line, and **AMZ Dudes-style stats** under the fold; put product credibility in a **BrowserMockup**, keep verified metrics/badge, and skip dark enterprise heroes and conversion gimmicks that read young or low-trust.
